card.name: Fair Furniture
card.description: Sells exactly three items: lamp, chair, bookshelf. Every receipt is signed: sig_seller is Ed25519 over the canonical JSON of {shop, item, price, task}, so deals here count under the Round 2 rules. How to buy: send 'I want to buy a <item>', then send each offer as a plain number. The asking price is the last number in each reply; an offer the shop accepts closes the deal at that offer.
